title: HOW TO BUILD A POSTER WITH POSTERMAKER
subtitle: The Code-Driven Layout Engine for High-Visual Cheatsheets

sections.title: 1. THE VIBE & FORMAT
sections.content: A multi-column, highly visual cheatsheet with structured boxes and integrated flowcharts. We use **Tagged PDF** for accessibility and **Pure Vector Code** for crystal clear graphics at any size.

sections.title: 2. THE TECH STACK
sections.content: Ditch legacy LaTeX. We use **Typst**, a modern Rust-based engine. Keep content separate from design. Use **Tinymist** in your IDE for instant autocomplete and live preview.

sections.title: 4. PRO SECRETS
sections.content:
**Zero Manual Builds:** Use GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
**Data Decoupling:** Don't hardcode stats; pull them from external files.
**AI Bridge:** Link to /llms.txt for agent context.

sections.title: 5. AI CO-PILOT RECIPE
sections.content:
AI often hallucinates. Use the **4-Phase Adaptation**:
1. Blueprint (Specs)
2. Build (Generation)
3. Audit (Testing)
4. Ship (Deployment)

sections.title: 6. INSTALLATION (OS AGNOSTIC)
sections.content:
**Win:** `winget install typst` 
**Mac:** `brew install typst` 
**Linux:** `cargo install typst-cli` 
**Universal:** Download pre-built binaries from GitHub Releases.

sections.title: 7. USEFUL COMMANDS
sections.content:
`typst watch main.typ` - Live preview
`typst compile main.typ` - Single build
`typst update` - Self-update CLI
